name: Last Stand
author: Wololoader
description: Co-op zombies-style survival mode. Every player, computer players included, defends one shared Castle against the Horde: endless rounds of Gaia raiders that spawn all around your bases and march on your buildings. Earn Points from kills and survived rounds, then spend them at the Castle on Mystery Boxes, perks (Juggernaut, Speed Cola, Pack-a-Punch), mercenaries, towers and supplies.

resources.name: Round
resources.description: The current round of the Horde in Last Stand.

resources.name: Next round
resources.description: Seconds until the next round of the Horde starts (0 while a round is being fought).

resources.name: Points
resources.description: +10 for every Horde kill, +50 for every round survived. Spend them at the Castle: Mystery Box, perks, mercenaries, towers, supplies.

game_modes.name: Last Stand
game_modes.description: Co-op zombies-style survival! Everyone defends a shared Castle against rounds of the Horde that grow nastier every round. Spend Points at the Castle on the Mystery Box and perks. The Castle falls and it is over.
